notes:
I don't have any notes on Isaiah 60 for you yet, because none of the research went through.

I tried to load six pages at once: the Enduring Word commentary on Isaiah 60, the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit commentaries on biblehub.com, Precept Austin's Isaiah 60 page and the NET Bible notes. The pages came back in a format my script didn't expect, so it crashed before I could read any of them. After that, the search-and-fetch tool would not let me make any more calls this turn. My other tools can't reach the web, so I had no other way to get at the sources.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes, tradition comparisons or "other views" from memory.

If you ask me to try again in a new turn, I'll fetch those six pages first and handle the format properly. Then I'll search the denominational sites (Ligonier, Desiring God, Seedbed, LCMS and so on) and the Catholic and Orthodox sites for anything on specific verses. The notes will be laid out verse by verse ("v. 1: …"), with a URL after every point, and verses with nothing found will be left out.
